items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: Woody was a great band leader. Great guy man. Boy, miss him. And I did five albums with him.

ctx.x: He got very popular. So Vegas, you know. But yeah like when I was with Woody’s band it was different traveling because we did one nighters. That was rough traveling.
